questions.text: Hi! I'm here to conduct your pre-surgery consultation. We'll go through some questions about your medical history and current health — it should only take a few minutes. Feel free to ask me anything along the way. Just let me know when you're ready to begin.
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has indicated they are ready to proceed.

questions.text: What is your name?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided a name.

questions.text: How old are you?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided an age.

questions.text: Have you ever had anesthesia before?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has clearly confirmed or denied prior anesthesia experience. Any affirmative (yes, once, twice, a few times) or denial (no, never) is complete.

follow_ups.text: Did you experience any problems with it?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient says yes, confirms, or implies they have had anesthesia before — including 'yes once', 'yes twice', 'a few times', etc.
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described any problems or side effects, or clearly stated there were none. Any direct response is complete.

questions.text: Has anyone in your family ever had an adverse reaction to anesthesia?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has clearly confirmed or denied family history of anesthesia reactions.

follow_ups.text: What type of reaction was it — for example, malignant hyperthermia, prolonged muscle relaxation, or something else?
follow_ups.trigger: patient confirms a family member had an adverse anesthesia reaction
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described the type of reaction, even if only approximately.

questions.text: Has a doctor ever told you that you were difficult to intubate or that you have a difficult airway?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has clearly confirmed or denied being told about a difficult airway.

questions.text: Do you have sleep apnea or use a CPAP machine at night?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied sleep apnea and CPAP use.

questions.text: Do you have any loose teeth, dentures, or dental implants?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied loose teeth, dentures, implants, or any other dental work.

questions.text: Do you have any allergies to medications, latex, or anesthesia drugs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied experiencing allergies

follow_ups.text: Which ones, and what kind of reaction do you get?
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has named specific allergens. General confirmation ('yes I have allergies') is not enough — actual allergen names are needed.

questions.text: Do you take any daily prescription medications?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied taking prescription medications

follow_ups.text: Could you list them for me?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient has confirmed or implied taking prescription medications but has not yet named them specifically
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has named at least one specific medication. Approximate names are acceptable (e.g. 'blood pressure pill' if they don't know the name).

questions.text: Do you take blood thinners such as aspirin, warfarin, Eliquis, or Xarelto?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied taking blood thinners (any clear denial is complete)

questions.text: Do you take any non-prescription medications, supplements, or herbal remedies — including things like fish oil, vitamins, or over-the-counter painkillers?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied taking non-prescription medications and supplements

follow_ups.text: Could you list what you're taking?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms taking non-prescription medications, supplements, or herbal remedies but has not yet listed them
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has listed specific items and confirmed the list is complete.

questions.text: Do you have any heart conditions, chest pain, or a history of heart surgery or stents?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied cardiac history.

questions.text: Do you have asthma, COPD, or any other breathing problems?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied respiratory conditions.

questions.text: Do you get short of breath when walking on flat ground or climbing stairs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied exertional shortness of breath.

questions.text: Do you experience acid reflux or heartburn, or take any medication for it?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied acid reflux symptoms and medication use.

questions.text: Have you had any recent infections, fever, or major health changes in the last few weeks?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied recent health changes.

questions.text: Do you smoke or use any nicotine products?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied smoking and nicotine use.

follow_ups.text: How long have you been using it, and roughly how much per day?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms current or recent smoking or nicotine use
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has provided any indication of duration OR frequency of use. Approximate answers are acceptable. If the patient cannot or does not know, that is also complete.

questions.text: How much alcohol do you consume on a weekly basis?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided an approximate weekly alcohol intake, or confirmed they do not drink.

questions.text: Do you use any recreational or illicit drugs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed or denied illicit drug use.

follow_ups.text: What do you use, and how often?
follow_ups.trigger: patient confirms using recreational or illicit drugs
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described what they use AND roughly how often. If the patient says they don't know the specific type, that is acceptable as long as frequency is given.

questions.text: Are you feeling anxious or worried about the anesthesia or the operation?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has expressed their emotional state regarding the procedure.

questions.text: Is there anything else about your health or previous surgeries that you think the anesthesiologist should know?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has either provided additional information or explicitly confirmed there is nothing more to add.

questions.text: Do you have any additional questions or concerns that you would like to discuss?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has either provided additional information or explicitly confirmed there is nothing more to add.
